title: On the Well-posedness of Magnetic Schrödinger Equations with Unbounded Potentials
summary: We consider magnetic Schrödinger equations with sublinear magnetic potentials and subquadratic electric potentials on $\mathbb{R}^{d}$, as well as generalizations thereof. We obtain new results on the global well-posedness of the Cauchy problem with initial data in magnetic modulation spaces $M^{p}_{A}(\mathbb{R}^{d})$. Our results are achieved by approximating the solution in phase space using the magnetic Hamiltonian flow.
